messages:
marcus: Heads-up: ArcheTech emailed with a proposal to run a thermal-first perf/W study on their NovaNPU boards. They want sustained 30m runs to quantify steady-state perf/W and thermal throttling behavior. Boards ETA Tue. Can we scope instrumentation and lab needs?
anya: Thermal-first is good. Need to confirm power measurement method: internal board PMIC telemetry vs external shunt + lab PDU. External shunt preferred for accuracy. Sampling granularity: 1Hz min, 10Hz ideal for transient spikes. Also request: raw voltage/current logs plus aggregated windowed averages.
li: Also important to capture LLM runtime behavior: KV cache warmup, attention-kernel hotpath, quantized INT8 vs FP16 regen. We'll run a warmup period and then a sustained measurement window. Suggest ignore first 5 minutes for warmup, then 30m steady-state.
sofia: I'll draft an experiment matrix focused on thermal variants: ambient (22C), elevated (35C in ThermoBox-24), and chassis-limited (open-air). Models: OPT-6.7B, Llama2-13B, and a small encoder-decoder for seq2seq. Batch sweep: 1,2,4,8. Seq lenses: 64, 256, 1024. Add a long-seq KV-only workload too.
kevin: Product/marketplace note: if we want a "Redwood + ArcheTech Perf Badge" we need an agreed metrics spec and a signed comms embargo. We'll need a 10-business-day review window after results. Also need legal to approve any partner logos.
sam_partner: ArcheTech confirms 4 dev boards for Redwood, driver engineer (tara) on standby, and the power harness kit (power_sense_v2) shipped with boards. We'll also provide power-harness calibration CSV. Ship ETA Tue EOD. Embargo OK.
tara: I'll be available for kernel/driver flips during the first integration days. Note: our early driver includes a perf-mode toggle that changes DVFS; if enabled it will bias results. We'll keep both a stock and perf-mode build.
labops-bot: Reservation confirmed: ThermoBox-24 booked 2024-05-06 08:00 - 2024-05-10 18:00 PT for partnership bench runs. Rack power strip #7 reserved.
anya: Calibration plan: 1) verify power_sense_v2 against lab reference PDU at 10W, 50W, 200W. 2) store calibration coefficients in s3://redwood-partner/archetech/calibration/YYYYMMDD.csv. 3) include calibration_sha in metadata.
li: Bench harness snippet (use bench-run v2):
```
./bench-run-v2 --profile arche_novanpu --model llama2-13b --batch 4 --seq 256 --warmup 300 --steady 1800 --trace perf,power,thermal --power-harness power_sense_v2 --out s3://redwood-partner/archetech/run-1743337777/ --tags run=thermal_v1,kernel=stock
```
sofia: Telemetry fields we require: run_id, runtime_git_sha, kernel_git_sha, driver_mode (stock|perf), board_serial, power_calib_sha, ambient_C, chamber_profile, sample_rate_hz. Also add notes for any manual interventions.
bench-bot: bench job created -> bench-1743337777-001, results path s3://redwood-partner/archetech/run-1743337777/, expected artifacts: perf.csv, power_raw.log, thermal_log.json, env_meta.json.
kevin: Timeline suggestion: Day 0-1 integration + calibration; Day 2 smoke runs + driver-mode checks; Day 3-7 matrix runs; Day 8 verification + partner mirrored runs; Day 9 writeup draft. Target joint blog review by week+2.
marcus: Risks: power harness miscalibration, driver perf-mode accidental use, thermal chamber drift. Mitigations: sign-off calibration step before matrix, hash all images and gates in CI, run mirror on partner infra.
li: Measurement rules: compute perf/W as tokens/sec / average_power_W during steady window. Report tokens/sec, avg power, perf/W, p50/p90/p99 latency for generation, and thermal delta (board_surface_before/after). Annotate any throttling events.
sofia: Action items (short): 1) Sofia -> post experiment matrix + acceptance spec by EOD. 2) Li -> bench config + presigned s3 path (will do by tomorrow). 3) Anya -> calibration checklist + perf counters list. 4) Marcus/Keven -> draft embargo + badge criteria and loop in legal. 5) Sam/Tara -> confirm board serials, power kit, and driver images.
sam_partner: Confirmed. We'll upload calibration CSV and driver images to partner dropbox and share presigned links.
marcus: I'll schedule a 30m kickoff Tues 09:30 PT and invite labops, runtime, eng-ml, and marketplace. If anyone can't make it, drop updates here. :thumbsup:
